name: The Vampire's Memories
source:
Melanie has always found change difficult. Timid and clumsy with words, she often alienates those around her, convinced she’ll never fit in.

When a Halloween party invitation arrives, she hopes for a chance at friendship. But she loses her way and ends up in a deserted house, where a vampire waits – ready to change everything.

[From [url=http://www.klaziki.com/stories.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
梅兰妮一直觉得改变很困难。她胆怯且言语笨拙，常常疏远周围的人，并坚信自己永远无法融入他人。

当万圣节派对邀请函送达时，她希望有机会建立友谊。但她迷了路，最终来到了一座废弃的房子里，吸血鬼在那里等待着——准备改变一切。

[来自[url=http://www.klaziki.com/stories.html]官方网站[/url]]
